rules.statement: The proviso of section 642 of the Civil Procedure Code is competent for the District Court to appoint a person to represent the deceased mortgagor's estate for the purposes of an action intended to recover a mortgage debt, even if the deceased had died before the Code came into operation.
rules.supporting_quote: The proviso stands independently of the testamentary chapters of the Code, and applies to cases where the deceased had died before as well as after the Code came into operation.
